mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and 68 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park, with a real-feel of 61 degrees.

The City of Verona has announced that the Common Council has unanimously adopted the Envision Verona Comprehensive Plan. This long-range strategy, developed with extensive community feedback, focuses on housing, sustainability, and supporting our local businesses and regional employment hubs for the next decade.

We have a busy schedule ahead. Today, you can check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, enjoy Thursday night festivities at ART House 360, or participate in trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
Looking at recent reports, on September 28, a 71-year-old man was cited for failing to keep his vehicle under control during a two-vehicle crash at the intersection of CTH-PB and CTH-M.
Culver's of Verona is currently open and serving until 10 PM. Stop in to discover today's flavor of the day before they close for the night.
